capabilities: Write tags, nested tags and ratings into JPEG, PNG, TIFF and WebP files
Browse folders and thumbnails with saved filters
Adjust exposure, color, levels, crop and rotation
Export or resize photos by tag, rating or folder
Detect duplicates, recognize faces and run semantic search
extras: Desktop-only beta; helpers are not installed automatically and settings include a Check helpers button. The optional 0.1.0 tools create a private Python environment and download packages from PyPI and models from Hugging Face. Version 0.0.3 removed the former digiKam database connection; database-only tags must be written to files first.
motivation: Your photos belong to you, and so should the work you put into organizing them.
problem: Tags and ratings made in photo applications are locked inside proprietary databases and are lost when folders move or the app changes.

relations.evidence: ExifTool updates metadata without re-encoding image pixels.

summary: Photo library manager that writes tags and ratings into image files, browses folders, and edits and exports photos.
